title: TaskExecutionPlan
root_cause: Router, CLI, extension, Studio, workflow, agent, and provider front doors do not compile to one immutable execution contract.
source_requirement: Add a validated, persisted, hash-bound TaskExecutionPlan that describes but never executes work.
implementation_steps: Persist immutable plans under project control state.
Adapt current router output into a plan without executing.
affected_tests: Routing, agent runtime, workflow Studio, provider gateway, and CLI tests.
evidence_required: Schema vectors, deterministic hash vectors, persistence and no-execute proof.
rollback: Keep old router output path available while removing only the plan adapter/projection.
acceptance_criteria: Every compiled plan is immutable, validated, hash-bound, and persisted.
The module performs no effectful execution.
